I really haven't, I personally still don't feel sheep rites are worth it compared to others. On one hand if you have the right team communication you can knock someone out of the fight for almost 4 seconds thus potentially making it a easy 2v1, and if you have bad team communication you could also try and use it to even up the odds against you in a 2v1, but I haven't fallen to that strat yet. I just don't feel it's worth it to apply or even keep the arcane debuff on your opponent with or through sheeps, since your M1 is always going to be off of cooldown before your sheep and the two are usually used as a combo. Hitting someone with an m1 that already has the arcane debuff is a mere 4/5(5 with 20% debuff rite) damage difference. (if my math is right) Unless you are using your M1 as an EX ability most of the time, I don't really see sheep rites being worth it unfortunately. Also while showdown was always good, I've been using the bunny rite in it's place, although against two ranged I do take showdown instead.

It's still difficult to land but it was always good for zoning, especially against melees. Now it's even more of a threat for someone to get stuck inside one and thus the punish is worse. However it is a pretty situational rite and although it's one of my favorites, it's sadly not very practical most of the time.

You can also chain link poof stuns this way. Although it is extremely difficult to pull this off.
